basic_info.description: Discover 45 Minerva Street, a rare opportunity in the desirable Oceanview neighborhood. This newly remodeled property is the perfect new beginning. Starting at the entry foyer, making your way past the 2 car side by side garage, you'll step up the stairway into the gorgeously lit main level of living. Expansive, south facing living room + dining areas welcome you with new floors, fireplace and tons of natural light - lazy Sunday afternoons are going to be perfect here. Make your way over to the cute, updated kitchen that pop with color and modern amenities - we love that meal prep isn't in isolation with the open concept layout. Finishing off the main level are 2 spacious bedrooms and a beautifully remodeled full bathroom with mosaic tiles, huge skylight, large walk in shower and brushed brass fixtures. Heading to the lower level, we invite you to a grand family room space with wet bar, access to the rear yard for indoor/outdoor living as well as a 3rd bedroom + full bath. Perfect primary suite setup, home office, lavish guest quarters or just a Netflix & Chill zone.  Located near Minnie & Lovie Rec Center, Balboa Park, and more. Neighboring schools include CAIS, Lick Wilmerding, Riordan, Stratford, Waldorf & Lowell.   No stone left unturned here, this home checks all the boxes.
